description: Weekly Transit Service Reference Data is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Public Transit", published or maintained by Federal Transit Administration. NOTE: With Federal Register Notice 91 FR 1856, the Federal Transit Administration approved a proposed recission of the WE-20 reporting requirement. As of January 15, 2026, transit agencies no longer submit weekly ridership data. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Public Transit". It has 12 columns, among them NTD ID, End Date, Begin Date, Value, Agency Name, Change from Prior Month. The portal shows 2026-01-07 as the last data update. Attribution given: Federal Transit Administration. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
